description:
## Problem
`src/vug/fetcher.cr:58` uses a bare `rescue nil`:

```crystal
@current_uri = URI.parse(@initial_url) rescue nil
```

A bare `rescue` in Crystal catches `Exception` (everything, including `SystemExit`, `NoMemoryError`, programming bugs). The same file already exports a `parse_uri_safe` helper that does this correctly with `rescue URI::Error`. The constructor should use it.

## Fix
Replace the inline `URI.parse(...) rescue nil` with a call to the existing private helper:

```crystal
@current_uri = parse_uri_safe(@initial_url)
```

## Why
- Correctness: avoid swallowing non-URI exceptions.
- DRY: reuses the helper that already exists 160 lines below.
- Style: ameba flags bare rescues.

## Acceptance
- [ ] `LoopState#initialize` calls `parse_uri_safe` instead of `URI.parse ... rescue nil`.
- [ ] `ameba src/` reports 0 failures.
- [ ] `crystal spec` (full suite) still passes.
- [ ] Public API unchanged (internal state class).

## Out of scope
- Do not move `LoopState` out of `Fetcher`.
title: fetcher: replace bare rescue in LoopState with parse_uri_safe
